title: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: The Sun Empire's warrior-poet and a planeswalker, who kills Vito, mourns her cousin Inti and gives his sword to Wayta.

entities.name: Inti
entities.description: Huatli's cousin and the Sun Empire's seneschal of the sun, killed in the battle and now an Echo in his sword's cosmium gem.

entities.name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
entities.description: A transformed bat-like vampire who dreams of being made a saint and is killed by Huatli.

entities.name: Pantlaza
entities.description: Huatli's dinosaur companion, who helps attack Vito and comforts her.

entities.name: Caparocti
entities.description: A Sun Empire champion appointed as the emperor's voice who clashes with Huatli over war.

entities.name: Wayta
entities.description: A young Sun Empire warrior who receives Inti's sword.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A siren and Brazen Coalition pirate who helps destroy the Mycotyrant's army and returns to a deserted Sunray Bay.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A goblin who fires a fiery weapon at the Mycotyrant.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A loxodon archaeologist and planeswalker who helps raise Abuela and explores Colony's End.

entities.name: Abuelo
entities.description: An Oltec Echo bound to a poncho.

entities.name: Abuela
entities.description: Abuelo's wife, restored as an Echo bound to her khipu.

entities.name: Akal Pakal
entities.description: The Oltec steward who mobilizes the gardeners.

entities.name: Anim Pakal
entities.description: Akal's sister and commander of the Thousand Moons.

entities.name: Amalia Benavides Aguirre
entities.description: A vampire cartographer who loses faith in Aclazotz and decides to travel with Kellan through an Omenpath.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young man from the fae realm searching for his father who fights beside Amalia and leaves through an Omenpath.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: The risen vampire god who escapes the Core on a ship to Torrezon.

entities.name: Chimil
entities.description: The god of the Core's sun, restored after Aclazotz's prison is broken.

entities.name: Mycotyrant
entities.description: A fungal overlord whose army is destroyed in the Core but whose spores survive and continue spreading.

entities.name: Vona de Iedo
entities.description: A vampire who rejected the church's teachings and whom Aclazotz wants at his right wing.

entities.name: Queen Miralda
entities.description: The queen of Torrezon.

entities.name: Saint Elenda
entities.description: A saint Vito calls false.

entities.name: Bartolomé del Presidio
entities.description: A vampire who died protecting Amalia and Kellan.

entities.name: Clavileño
entities.description: Vito's soldier, turned into a monster.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker and Malcolm's former captain who Malcolm has heard died in the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Tan Jolom
entities.description: An Oltec figure who sends Echoes to help.

entities.name: Ojer Kaslem
entities.description: An Oltec god who will aid the gardeners.

entities.name: Ojer Axonil
entities.description: An Oltec god of fire and storms.

entities.name: Caztaca Huicintli
entities.description: The emperor's sister who invites Huatli to Otepec.

entities.name: Asterion
entities.description: Quint's former colleague who died at Zantafar.

entities.name: The Core
entities.description: The hollow world under Ixalan where the final battle takes place.

entities.name: Cosmium reef
entities.description: A floating field of cosmium shards where aerial battle rages.

entities.name: Oteclan
entities.description: The Oltec place where the second Sun Empire delegation arrives.

entities.name: Colony's End
entities.description: A huge ruined colonizer ship embedded in a mountain with intact tanks.

entities.name: Otepec
entities.description: A city to which Huatli is invited.

entities.name: Sunray Bay
entities.description: A town deserted and marked by the Mycotyrant's spores.

entities.name: High and Dry
entities.description: A pirate port that Malcolm fears is next.

entities.name: Downtown
entities.description: The mining camp that remains empty.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The golden city.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The vampire homeland Aclazotz plans to conquer.

entities.name: Zantafar
entities.description: A site Quint explored where Asterion died.

entities.name: Thousand Moons
entities.description: The Oltec warriors led by Anim Pakal.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: The people of the Core.

entities.name: Gardeners
entities.description: Oltec specialists with staves and Echoes who fight the Mycotyrant.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire of Huatli and Caparocti.

entities.name: Dusk Legion
entities.description: The vampires transformed by Aclazotz.

entities.name: Cosmium eaters
entities.description: Aclazotz's worshippers in the Core.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: The pirate alliance that Malcolm serves.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Merfolk who retreat to their ocean.

entities.name: Queen's Bay Company
entities.description: The company through which Amalia sends warnings home.

entities.name: Colonizers
entities.description: Giants whose dark vessels caged Chimil in a metal prison, according to Oltec stories.

entities.name: Echo
entities.description: A spirit bound to an object; Echoes counter the fungus by turning themselves into a sickness.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: A swirling portal between planes that Amalia and Kellan enter.

entities.name: Night War
entities.description: A past war with the colonizers commemorated in Oteclan.

events.summary: Huatli cradles Inti's dead body as battle rages above.
events.quote: Huatli cradled the broken body of her cousin, kneeling in the blood-spattered soil of a land far from home.

events.summary: Transformed Vito arrives to capture Huatli for Aclazotz.
events.quote: Aclazotz will be pleased when I deliver you to him

events.summary: Vito boasts of making himself a saint and of ruling at Aclazotz's side with Vona.
events.quote: Together, Vona and I will rule at our master's side

events.summary: Huatli calls on the land's magic as she fights Vito.
events.quote: She called to the mountains and forests, the fields and valleys.

events.summary: Huatli twists Vito's lance out of his hand.
events.quote: She caught it in the gap of her shield, twisting the weapon out of his hand.

events.summary: Dinosaurs, including Pantlaza, swarm Vito.
events.quote: A flying dinosaur barreled into him, sending him tumbling to the ground.

events.summary: Huatli kills Vito with his own lance through the heart.
events.quote: The lance slid through the vampire's plate armor, piercing his vile heart and pinning him to the ground.

events.summary: Vito dies asking Aclazotz why he forsook him.
events.quote: why have you forsaken me?

events.summary: Huatli promises Inti she will return after every vampire in the Core is eradicated.
events.quote: promising Inti that she would return when every vampire in the Core was eradicated.

events.summary: Malcolm recalls that Vraska reportedly died in the invasion.
events.quote: She'd died in the invasion, or so he'd heard.

events.summary: Quint and Abuelo restore Abuela as an Echo, who warns that the Mycotyrant nears.
events.quote: Everyone, this is Abuela.

events.summary: The gardeners arrive and summon Echoes anchored to heirloom objects.
events.quote: Spirits burst into existence, anchored to the items.

events.summary: Akal sends the gardeners to preserve the land while the Thousand Moons fight to save Chimil.
events.quote: While our Thousand Moons fight to save Chimil, you must preserve the land for their return.

events.summary: Amalia offers to help by using her map magic on the land.
events.quote: I can change the land with my map.

events.summary: Amalia carves a fissure in front of the Mycotyrant's army.
events.quote: a deep crevice lay in the path of the army, encircling them so retreat would be difficult.

events.summary: The mycoids bridge the fissure with their own bodies.
events.quote: soon a thick bridge spanned the crevice.

events.summary: Echoes destroy mycoids by entering them as a counter-infection.
events.quote: It dissolved into blue smoke as if consumed by invisible fire.

events.summary: Gardeners burn mycoids with waves of pink light.
events.quote: Every fungus the light touched burst into flames.

events.summary: Breeches pulls out a flowery tube weapon he got in High and Dry.
events.quote: From his pack, he retrieved the weapon he'd acquired in High and Dry as payment for a debt.

events.summary: Breeches fires a molten fireball that fells a titan and sends the colony into disarray.
events.quote: Every fungal creature around it shrieked in unison, some collapsing like puppets whose strings had been cut.

events.summary: The casing around the sun shifts apart and light shines through again.
events.quote: As the dust cleared, the casing around the sun shifted apart slowly, almost imperceptibly.

events.summary: Wayta spots a temple of Aclazotz revealed in a sheared mountain face.
events.quote: Pillars of a great temple rose from the sheared mountain face.

events.summary: Anim sends the Thousand Moons to destroy the cosmium eaters.
events.quote: My Moons, come. We will root out the disease of cosmium eaters and end them as well.

events.summary: Kellan beheads a vampire while Amalia looks away.
events.quote: bringing his sword together like scissors, Kellan took off her head.

events.summary: The Thousand Moons find the temple empty and Aclazotz gone.
events.quote: Aclazotz is gone

events.summary: A captured cosmium eater says Aclazotz is free and will end the Fifth Age.
events.quote: He gathers his children, and soon he will end the Fifth Age and begin a new age of blood.

events.summary: The eater calls Amalia a traitor for abandoning Aclazotz.
events.quote: Traitor. We saw you run when you were called.

events.summary: Amalia grieves Bartolomé's death and Vito's rightness about their god.
events.quote: Bartolomé died to protect her and Kellan, but his sacrifice was in vain.

events.summary: Amalia tells Kellan she feels she has been living a lie about her faith.
events.quote: I feel as if I've been living a lie.

events.summary: The second Sun Empire delegation reaches Oteclan to find Chimil restored while pyres burn.
events.quote: The second Sun Empire delegation reached Oteclan a week after the battle, to find Chimil restored to her previous glory even as pyres of the dead burned.

events.summary: Caparocti is appointed the emperor's voice in negotiations.
events.quote: Caparocti sat at Steward Akal's left hand, having been appointed the emperor's voice in the proceedings.

events.summary: Quint casts an eavesdropping spell so Wayta can hear the talks.
events.quote: Pulling a scroll from his pack, Quint cleared his throat.

events.summary: Huatli and Caparocti argue over invading Torrezon and Huatli warns him off.
events.quote: And yet your title was stolen for you by your cousin Inti rather than granted by the late emperor.

events.summary: The Oltec decide they cannot ignore the surface any longer.
events.quote: You stand ready to see the surface for yourself

events.summary: Huatli gives Inti's cosmium-pommeled sword to Wayta, saying his Echo is in the gem.
events.quote: He's an Echo now. His spirit is here, in the gem.

events.summary: Huatli announces an invitation to Otepec from the emperor's sister.
events.quote: I've received an invitation to Otepec from the emperor's sister.

events.summary: Malcolm and Breeches climb out of the caverns and head for Sunray Bay.
events.quote: Climbing back out of the caverns had almost been worse than going in.

events.summary: Sunray Bay is found deserted and marked by spores.
events.quote: Sunray Bay was as deserted as Downtown, with the same signs of the Mycotyrant's handiwork

events.summary: Malcolm decides to warn High and Dry.
events.quote: We need to get to High and Dry

events.summary: Kellan and Amalia find an Omenpath.
events.quote: That's it. An Omenpath.

events.summary: Amalia sends word of Aclazotz's threat home through the Queen's Bay Company.
events.quote: she had sent word to her family and Queen Miralda through the remaining Queen's Bay Company members of the oncoming storm Aclazotz might bring.

events.summary: Amalia chooses to leave her world with Kellan and they leap through the Omenpath.
events.quote: Without another word, they leaped through the Omenpath, and everything changed.

events.summary: Quint explores Colony's End, a huge metal ruin.
events.quote: The place the Oltec called Colony's End jutted from the side of a mountain

events.summary: Quint recalls the Oltec story of colonizers whose vessels caged Chimil.
events.quote: Their stories described giants whose great, dark vessels appeared in the sky, blotting out the light of Chimil and then caging her within a metal prison.

events.summary: Quint finds coin bas-reliefs at the entrance to the ruin.
events.quote: bas-reliefs depicting the same coin motifs he'd discovered elsewhere.

events.summary: Quint finds a room of shattered tanks and one intact tank.
events.quote: this one held a long row of massive tanks, their glass fronts shattered

events.summary: Quint's touch lights up the intact tank, revealing a huge creature.
events.quote: With a deep clang, the tank lit up.

events.summary: The creature in the tank flexes its hand into a fist.
events.quote: The creature's fingers twitched.

events.summary: The Mycotyrant's surviving colony infects vampires camped in a jungle temple.
events.quote: One of them struck a swollen fungal sac with its blade, releasing a cloud of spores that settled on its skin like flies.

events.summary: The colony's hosts reach High and Dry aboard a ship, hiding behind dark lenses.
events.quote: A new body stood on the deck of a ship—such useful things, ships—and watched as it approached High and Dry.

events.summary: Aclazotz, in the hold of a ship bound for Torrezon, plans to conquer it and later destroy Chimil.
events.quote: Soon the ship would reach Torrezon, a land of sheep awaiting their promised shepherd to lead them to eternal life.

events.summary: Aclazotz singles out Vona de Iedo as the vampire he wants at his right wing.
events.quote: One vampire he craved above all others: Vona de Iedo, the Antifex.

relations.note: ran him through with his own lance
relations.quote: The lance slid through the vampire's plate armor, piercing his vile heart and pinning him to the ground.
Huatli cradled the broken body of her cousin
Wrinkled lips stretched in a smile as she peered up at Abuelo.
they would return to Chimil and obliterate her at last.

relations.note: he wants her at his right wing
relations.quote: He would set her at his right wing to see that his will be done.
while her sister at her other elbow gestured widely
having been appointed the emperor's voice in the proceedings

relations.note: bitter quarrel over war with Torrezon
relations.quote: Do not look for me again, Champion, because you will find me.
The army of the Mycotyrant spread across the pristine land
